3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The faint murmur of the crowd outside seeped into Palas Rezna's second-floor sitting room, its restlessness contrasting with the stillness inside.

4.speaker: Hugo Toras
4.text: "Romus, as you stand before your subjects today, remember that history is written by the victors."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "We must not falter, lest ATO engulf Southern Merkopa in its ever-expanding grasp."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: The walls of this solemn chamber were adorned with the dignified portraits of my ancestors – King Valero, Queen Lyza, and the long lineage of House Toras stretching back to its inception.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: Hugo peered out towards the balcony, then turned to face me, his expression as solemn as I'd ever seen it.

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "The international community and the AN are against us. The world order they are creating is a farce!"

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "They tried to attack me in Zille but failed. Now, a new threat rises from the south. We will fight our enemies on every front, and we will win."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Our future hangs in the balance. If we do not confront the threat at our southern border now, it will consume us."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "In the past, I sought to bridge our differences, engaging in earnest diplomacy with the Duke of Pales. Look at where that got us."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Duke Reinhart's broken promises and lack of honor are a stark betrayal of our trust and the principles of this kingdom."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Princess Vina journeyed to Pales in the spirit of diplomacy. By keeping her there, Duke Reinhart abused our trust."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "The very honor of our kingdom has been placed at stake. Our royal house attacked, our successor stolen from us."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "The wrongful detainment of Vina is a test of our resolve, sent by divine providence. Together, we will overcome it."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "With all my might and righteousness, I promise to return the princess and show our enemies our true strength."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "That Pales would do this to a true daughter of Rizia reflects their desperation and dishonor."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "In stark contrast to their barbarity, we shall demonstrate our civility and honor. We shall not stoop to their level."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "The future of Rizia and its people depends on reliable energy sources that feed our industry and growth."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "For a safe and secure Rizia, we embark on this path to reclaim what destiny has decreed as ours."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "Whether in Pales or Zille, we will stop at nothing to safeguard what our God has bestowed upon us."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "In a surprising twist of fate, Valgsland has shown greater integrity than many who claimed to share our values."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Derdia stood with us as a powerful regional friend also facing international pressure for its way of life."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "We found support from our neighbors in Morella, who refused to let political differences get in the way of justice."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Our valiant sons and daughters have stood resolute, safeguarding our heritage and cultural treasures from foreign encroachment."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "God was with us that day as we expelled the enemy from our precious land and paleaccis."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "I solemnly vow to avenge these vile actions. We will counter every blow, return every volley and strike fear into the heart of the Palesians."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "There are those who accuse me of merely following in the footsteps of my father. But I am determined to carve my own path as king."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "The legacy of King Valero, my father, will be rectified under my reign, correcting the course of history."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "I fight this war in honor of the legacy of His Majesty King Valero. Together, we can fulfill his dream of a reunited Rizia."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "Chosen by divine will, the message is clear: this war is destined for our triumph."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "The reasons for this war should be self-evident. I do not need to waste my time justifying them to you."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "Ancient texts prophesy the conquest of Pales by Rizia. We will win this war because it is our divine destiny."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "This war is about our way of life. Pales is threatening our people as well as our principles."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "Visions have come to me, foretelling conflict; a divine sign that our path is righteous."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Today, we stand united, not in celebration, but in solemn duty."

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: I stepped out onto the balcony and took in the immense scene unfolding before me. A sea of people stretched across the palace gardens and the streets beyond them, fading far into the distance.

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: As I approached the microphone, silence spread throughout the mass. Their attention focused entirely on me.

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "As they have done in the past, our friends in Wehlen came through for us on the global stage."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Rizia was struck first by Pales, our long-standing adversary, reigniting a conflict that has been simmering for years."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "We sent our navy to Aureus because we feared the Palesians would disrespect our claim to the field. With their attack, they proved us right."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "They crossed our border and attacked land that belonged to Rizia for centuries. They escalated this conflict."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Our peaceful nation now faces war, imposed by our southern neighbor."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "As we prepare to engage with Pales once again, we must let our faith and unity be our guiding light."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "I want each and every one of you to listen to what your King has to say."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "I appear before you today with a grave message."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Followers of the Almighty and the one."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "The next few months will be a chance for Rizia to prove its resilience."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "The events that are about to occur will test us, yet also define us."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "In our efforts for peace, we have reached out to Pales time and time again. Each time, we have been met with betrayal and aggression. Enough is enough."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "Our borders, our sacred lands, were violated. We stand not as aggressors, but as defenders of our home."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "The unprovoked attack on our navy, the sinking of the RRN Valero, was a clear declaration of war. We have no choice but to respond in kind."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "The abduction of Princess Vina, a symbol of our future, is an attack not just on the crown, but on every Rizian citizen."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Confronted with the Duke's escalating threats, our hand is forced; we rise now to shield the very heart of Rizia."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "The treachery of Duke Axel Reinhart compels us to act. It is our duty to protect our nation from his deceitful maneuvers."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "The loss of RRN Valero -- named after my father -- is a wound to our nation."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "In honoring the brave souls lost at sea, we pledge to resist Palesian naval aggression while holding every life sacred."
110.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false)

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "By keeping our heiress as a hostage, the Palesians have shown their flagrant disrespect for the Rizian royal family."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "We will not rest until justice is served for the wrongful imprisonment of our future queen."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "Under the watchful gaze of the world, we shall rise, showcasing the indomitable spirit that courses through Rizia's veins."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "The unjust attack on our naval forces was a clear act of aggression by Pales against Rizia. One that demanded an aggressive response."
114.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false)

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "Pales' pre-emptive claim to Aureus and its subsequent border raid were two sides of the same coin of aggression."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "The incursion on our lands by Pales was an undeniable declaration of war against our sovereign nation."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "Yielding full control of the Aureus reserves was not an option. Our nation's future depends on these critical resources."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "Our diplomatic clash over Aureus marks a prelude to the tensions we face today with Pales."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "Our many international allies helped us secure a partial claim to Aureus. With their support, we will win the entire field."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "In the face of global injustice, we stand firm in defending our rightful claim to Aureus."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Despite the AN ruling in favor of Pales, we stand here today, resolute in defending our nation against their encroachment."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "Lespia has swayed the Alliance of Nations against us. But today, we face Pales with the conviction of our cause."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "Our enemies tried to tempt us with temporary gains. Yet we chose the path of self-reliance."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "Ou refusal to be subjugated in the Aureus deal reflects our broader stance against Palesian aggression."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "Pales's violation of our historic landmarks, following our purchase of the rights to Aureus, left us no choice but to act."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "Pales attacked our very border, hoping we would cede our legally purchased rights to Aureus. We refused to give in."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Our stance on Aureus, backed by the Royal Navy, was a clear signal that Rizia will stop at nothing to protect our maritime rights."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "The Palesians dared to challenge us at sea, encroaching upon our rights and attacking our brave sailors - an act of undeniable hostility."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "Once we capture Pales, we will gain full control of Aureus and finally achieve energy autonomy."

153.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
153.text: Talk about the gas field arbitration.

154.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
154.text: Talk about Vina being taken hostage.

156.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
156.text: Talk about the naval incident that occurred.

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "As Lespia's influence in Pales grows, we find ourselves compelled to act, not just for Rizia, but for balance in our region."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "The shadow of Lespia and the Arcasian Treaty Organization looms large over Pales. We wage this war to counter their encroaching influence."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "We must shield our part of the continent against Lespia's expanding reach before it is too late."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "We are fighting for nothing less than our kingdom's economic future."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Expanding our borders, securing resources – this war is a step towards a greater, more prosperous Rizia."

184.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
184.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedVinaHostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_Generic"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedBorderIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true

185.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
185.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedVinaHostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_Generic"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedBorderIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true) == false

187.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
187.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedVinaHostage"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_Generic"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedBorderIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_TalkedNavalIncident"] == true

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "It is a regrettable twist of the knife that Wehlen, despite years of alliance, refrained from standing by us when it mattered most."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "Morella's stance in the global forum has been a letdown, straying far from the cameraderie we expected."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Our expectation was for Derdia to empathize with our plight. Yet their stance left us disillusioned."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Our partial victory at the AN was bittersweet. We won the battle over Aureus, but the war has only just begun."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "The Alliance of Nations ruled in our favor. Yet accepting their resolution would mean accepting defeat."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Gaining partial rights to Aureus at the AN was not enough. For the sake of Rizian energy independence, we must fight for more."

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Despite our earnest efforts at arbitration, the AN's ruling against Rizia left our nation vulnerable, compelling us to act."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "The AN's unfair ruling over the Aureus field has forced our hand, to defend our territory against external biases."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "Lespia and the AN have conspired to rob us of what is rightfully ours. In the face of such injustice, our only recourse is to stand up for Rizia."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "The Palesians were not content to attack our sovereignty. They made this conflict personal by taking my daughter."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "Vina's abduction is an attack on our royal heart. Our war is also a crusade to bring our princess home."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "Guided by divine vision, this war is not just a political act, but a fulfillment of a higher, sacred duty."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "This war is as much about honor as it is about strategic gain. It is up to me to complete my father's unfinished quest."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "While this war may seem like a defensive measure, it is also a path to our national as well as my personal glory."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "Dear Rizian soldiers, pilots, and sailors, today you embark on a great, great conquest. A conquest that will end with the greatest triumph Rizia has ever seen."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "Our troops are the guardians of our kingdom, the brave hearts who stand at the forefront of this critical moment in our history."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "Each one of you carries the spirit of Rizia into battle – a spirit unyielding, courageous, and proud."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "As you defend our borders, skies, and seas, know that you carry with you the hopes and prayers of every single Rizian."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "In you, the legacy of our forefathers and foremothers lives on – a legacy of resilience, honor, and the will to protect our homeland."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "Your actions in the coming weeks will be remembered, your likenesses carved into stone, your names preserved throughout history."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "May your courage light the path to victory, and may your steadfastness inspire generations to come."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "House Azaro, our warriors, shall lead us into battle. General Taddeus and his daughter Lucita will not fail us."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "We are supported by the esteemed Azaros of Cardesse-Montaklar, whose military prowess and strategic acumen inspires not only their home province but the whole kingdom."

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "House Azaro will be the sword and shield of Rizia in these times of conflict."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "In this fateful hour, we are lucky to have House Sazon standing with us."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "The members of House Sazon join our ranks, setting aside past differences for the greater good of Rizia."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "House Sazon of Brenas will be key allies in this fight, harnessing the knowledge and youthful energy of their province to outwit and outmaneuver the enemy."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "I will remind the members of House Sazon how lenient my family has been to them in the past. They will support us in this war or else."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "Of course, I will be leading Rizia into battle with the entire Toras royal family by my side."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "My cousin Rico Toras, with his unbridled valor and loyalty, embodies the spirit of our house – a spirit that will lead us to victory."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "I call upon my relatives in House Toras, stewards of Valenqiris and the throne, to take up arms in defense of the ancient values and traditions that define our golden kingdom."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Noble houses of Rizia, your allegiance in this crucial hour fortifies the soul of our nation."

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "Each house, with its history and legacy, brings a unique strength to our collective endeavor – together, we will not be defeated."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "As the pillars of Rizian society, your commitment and leadership are the beacons guiding us to victory."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "With two centuries on the throne behind us, House Toras rises to meet this moment."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "To the people of Rizia, the soul of our nation, now is the time to rise, to join the ranks of those who defend our land."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "I look out at all of you, and I see the true power of this kingdom."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "Each citizen's effort, whether on the battlefield or at home, will make a difference in our victory."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I call upon the youth of Rizia to take up the mantle of defense. It is your turn to write your own chapter in our storied history."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Your enlistment, your support and your sacrifices are the building blocks of a free, victorious, and prosperous Rizia."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Together, we are an unbreakable force; united, we will face this challenge and emerge as one."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "In every street and every home of Rizia, your determination fuels our nation's spirit against all odds."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "From the fields to the factories, your contributions fortify the very foundations upon which our kingdom stands."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "To the elders of Rizia, your wisdom and guidance in these turbulent times light our path forward."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "Your collective will, the heartbeat of Rizia, resonates louder than the drums of war."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "This is but the first step on a long journey towards a grander Rizia, the likes of which the world has not seen since the days of Queen Lyza."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "As we stand on the brink of destiny, our collective resolve must not waver. For every challenge faced, Rizia stands taller, prouder."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "As we begin this difficult journey, remember that every step you take is a stride towards our shared destiny."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "This land of ours, with its rolling hills, fertile soil and ancient cities, calls for its children to protect its legacy. For Rizia, for our future!"

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "In these times of uncertainty, let our shared hopes bind us. Each act of courage, small or large, weaves a brighter tomorrow."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "House Toras, our royal lineage, stands as the unshakable pillar of Rizia, guiding our nation with wisdom and honor."

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: "To our esteemed paratroopers, your bravery and swiftness are the wings upon which our hopes soar."

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "Our stalwart mountaineers will brave rugged terrain and harsh conditions to drive away the enemy."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "Our mechanized forces, swift and relentless, are the driving force that propels us towards victory with unmatched speed and agility."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "To the mighty Rizian Fleet, masters of the seas, I expect you to blow Pales out of the water. Quite literally."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "I ask our Lord God to watch over you in battle. May His mercy be your shield; His wrath your sword."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "Soldiers of Rizia, you are the hammer that will forge our victory. March forth with the might and conviction that our cause is just and true!"

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "When the historians write of the Second Pales War, let it be written that it was you, the valiant protectors of Rizia, who turned the tide. Your deeds today will echo for generations."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "Many of you will die. But know that you are making this sacrifice so that your children, and your children's children, may see a brighter tomorrow."

277.speaker: Narrator
277.text: The deployed soldiers around the palace were listening attentively and saluted.

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "To our foreign intelligence operatives, your unseen efforts will be crucial in making sure we are always one step ahead of Pales."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "The Golden Guard, a formidable force of loyalty and might, shall defend Rizia as capably as they have defended their king."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Our provincial divisions will serve as the vanguard of our army, leading the charge on behalf of their ancestral lands."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "Each of you brings your own knowledge and skill set onto the battlefield. Cooperate with each other, and you will be unstoppable."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "Together, our noble houses represent the backbone of Rizia. With your help, we will stand tall against our adversaries."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "In our language, culture, tradition, lies our indomitable strength; together we confront our enemy, emerging more robust and united as a single nation."

313.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
313.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_AddressRRAF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_AddressPeople"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_SpeechWarHub_AddressToras"] == true) == false

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Surrounded by adversaries, our only path to safety is to meet them on the battlefield."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "Caught in the crossfire of CSP and ATO's global strife, we stand firm against their encroachment. Rizia bows to no one."

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "Our preparations were not in vain. They were the first steps toward an inevitable domination, a display of our unchallenged might."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "We prepared for this conflict out of necessity, not blood lust. We stand not as aggressors, but as guardians of our homeland's security."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "Our readiness for war reflects our commitment to protect Rizia at all costs, even if it means striking first."

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: The crowd erupted in a tumultous roar of approval. My subjects' excitement was palpable.

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: Waves of enthusiastic applause began to sweep through the crowd, their energy building as they hung on every word.

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: Murmurs of approval rippled through the crowd, my subjects' attention sharpening as my words resonated with them.

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: The crowd's silence permeated the air. They regarded me in calm anticipation of my next words.

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "The true colors of our fellow nations have now been revealed, unmasking a world of shallow promises and hidden agendas."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "No matter what they throw at us, we will stand tall. They will not infringe on our rights."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "When the AN refused to rule in our favor, we sent our navy as a sign that we would not back down."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I applaud our navy for taking swift action to safeguard Rizian interests following the AN resolution."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Our partial victory at the AN was just the start. Our naval actions thereafter affirmed our determination."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "I say to you that the Aureus ruling marks a new chapter in our relentless pursuit of justice and sovereignty."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "This incident proved that a nation's sovereign borders cannot be determined by committee. Only God knows the truth."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "In the wake of these events, let it be clear: no decision can sway our commitment to protect what is ours by history and by right."

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "The AN has spoken. Yet true verdicts are written not in chambers of debate, but in the hearts of a people united for their cause."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "I am counting on our brave troops to rescue Her Highness before the unspeakable happens."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "We shall unleash the full fury of Rizia to reclaim our princess. No one will dare challenge our royal lineage again."

371.speaker: Player_Romus
371.text: "Though we mourn our losses, our swift victory against the Palesian forces reaffirms our unyielding defense of our territory."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "Each Rizian life lost hardens our determination to win. We've repelled the Palesians, a mere prelude to the retribution they'll face."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "Our brave soldiers triumphed, paying a heavy price to push back the invaders. Their sacrifice fuels our fight for freedom."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "In the shadow of conflict and loss, we emerged victorious, more determined than ever to secure a future free of the Palesian threat."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "The Palesian soldiers lurking at our borders will be given no quarter. Our response will be swift and decisive, a clear message to our foes."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "We stand vigilant, ready to counter any Palesian aggression. Our military remains poised and ready."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "Let those Palesian soldiers dare to tread on our land; they will meet the full might of Rizia's wrath, a lesson they won't forget."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "Our borders are secure, watched by unblinking eyes. Any Palesian folly will be met with appropriate and calculated force."

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "In a display of honor, we released the Palesian ships, prioritizing humanity over hostility even in the midst of conflict."

388.speaker: Player_Romus
388.text: "Our decision to free Palesian vessels was a commitment to our values, even as we braved the storm to save the Valero."

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "By aiding friend and foe alike at sea, we demonstrated the strength of Rizian compassion and integrity."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "Daring to rescue all, we extended our efforts to Palesian sailors, embodying the true spirit of Rizian heroism."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "Our frigates, amidst turmoil, sought to save every soul, solidifying our legacy as a nation that values every life, whether friend or foe."

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "Our focus remained on the Valero, a duty to our own above all, in a decisive moment of kinship and loyalty."
395.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true)

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "While we sent aid to Palesian sailors, our heart was with the Valero, affirming our allegiance to those who bear our flag."
396.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true)

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "In the chaos of battle, our aim was clear: rescue the Valero first. We knew we would need our flagship for the battles to come."
397.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true)

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: Looking out at the crowd, I saw my citizens chanting, applauding and fervently waving flags.

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: Looking out at the crowd, I sensed an undercurrent of energy. Sporadic claps and shouts emerged, and Rizian flags began waving in the air.

400.speaker: Narrator
400.text: Looking out at the crowd, I saw subtle nods of encouragement among my supporters. My message was beginning to take root.

401.speaker: Narrator
401.text: Looking out at the crowd, I saw pensive expressions. My citizens were absorbing the gravity of my words with quiet introspection.

411.speaker: Narrator
411.text: As I finished my speech, an explosive cheer erupted, the crowd's exuberance reaching its zenith, echoing triumphantly through Porte Drazon.

412.speaker: Narrator
412.text: In the final moments, fervent cheers and applause erupted, a potent mix of passion and resolve filling the air.

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: As the speech neared its end, the crowd's energy bubbled over, their enthusiasm growing into a loud, rhythmic show of support.

414.speaker: Narrator
414.text: With my concluding words, a murmur of agreement swelled into a chorus of assent, the first sparks of excitement igniting.

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: Rizia's fate teetered on the edge.

425.speaker: Narrator
425.text: War, war was a never-changing subject, repeating its age-old story.

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "In the throes of conflict, we captured Palesian vessels, successfully protecting our Valero and its crew."
430.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false)

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "Our decision to capture enemy ships, foregoing rescue, was a strategic move, dictated by the urgent need to protect our naval pride."
431.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false)

432.speaker: Player_Romus
432.text: "With the Valero at stake, we opted for capture over aid, a harsh but vital choice to maintain our maritime superiority."
432.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_RescueBoth"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FreeShips"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true) == false)

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "Our Rizian Royal Navy stands as a pivotal force, ready to bolster our land units and sever the lifelines of enemy supplies."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "With the war already raging at sea, we brace for the inevitable clash on land. We must prepare for the many trials ahead."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "Our future now rests in the capable hands of our valiant sailors, guardians of our destiny at sea."

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "Reinhart has forsaken his own people's interests. He is nothing but a puppet to foreign powers. We will cut his strings."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "From Moridia's Gulf to Sudis, then across to the Antacean Sea, our lands will stand unshackled, our people resolutely free."

488.speaker: Player_Romus
488.text: "This incident proved that a nation's sovereign borders cannot be determined by committee. We in Rizia know the truth."

489.speaker: Player_Romus
489.text: "Vina is an innocent in all this. We cannot let the Palesians punish her simply for seeking peace."

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "As if that weren't enough, Pales and their Lespian cronies had the temerity to accuse Duchess Lucita Azaro -- one of Rizia's most upstanding noblewomen -- of instigating the attack. We cannot stand for this."

494.speaker: Player_Romus
494.text: "I have always seen through the self-styled 'Duke' Axel Reinhart and his sham of a Grand Duchy. It is time for the facade to come crashing down."

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "Your valor and sacrifice are the bedrock upon which the future of our nation rests. We owe you an immeasurable debt of gratitude."
